llms:
Network reachability wavefront

- reached nodes: 1,199
- 8 recorded key frames
- Colour encodes first finite round
- Each frame is a valid execution prefix on apple · single-hop, not the only possible one.
- 8 of 9 recorded frames, evenly sampled with first and final retained. All 1199 nodes and 2810 edges rasterized at 160×90 (key frames 96×54); overlapping pixels use draw order. Node picking decimated to at most 8 evenly sampled keys plus the pinned key.
- Step capture splits queue submissions
- Hatched replay re-runs the graph with activeIterations limited
- compute passes were not coalesced as in production
- lens twin: transients costs, bands, predecessors, bandCounts, converged, iterationCount, reachability-queued-round, reachability-control retained instead of aliased

Provenance: values read back from the GPU run.
Adapter: apple (unknown) · single-hop.
